name: 钴蓝撞色罐装营养补剂款
description: 钴蓝斜切撞色罐装补剂套图，白底主图加空白参数表与空印章墙

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating bright key field #FFFFFF, cool light field #F2F5F7 and one saturated brand field #0C5DA6, every frame split by a hard diagonal colour wedge edged in deep ink #101820
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, frontal key with a soft fill card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the container, no harsh speculars, macro shots lit by a single skimming light
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless studio sweep #FFFFFF and matte board #F2F5F7, container always sitting flush with a real contact shadow
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with heavy condensed display weights and hairline rules; all printed areas are carried as blank bars and empty ruled rows, never as legible characters
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight circular seal frames with two short blank bars inside, outlined in deep ink #101820 on a bright interior #FFFFFF, no filled pictograms and no real certification marks
styleLock.presentationRules: the wide-mouth tub stays upright at stable scale with its label face toward camera across the set; angle, size and cap position must not drift between shots
noDrift: no legible words, digits or barcodes inside blank panels
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical sports-nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a bright key field #FFFFFF, a cool light field #F2F5F7, one saturated brand field #0C5DA6 and deep ink #101820 for outlines and rules; cool studio tone held across the set; every frame split by a hard diagonal colour wedge; modern geometric sans-serif with heavy condensed display weights and hairline rules; consistent thin single-weight circular seal frames and blank label bars; bright even high-key lighting with a frontal key, soft fill card and one soft contact shadow; the wide-mouth container always upright at stable scale with its label face toward camera; all printed areas rendered as flat blank panels, empty ruled rows and empty seal frames, never as legible characters; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图一为纯背景罐装正面主图，右下角斜切色块、肩部级三格参数条与两枚圆形印章；图二为深场底营养成分表信息图，标题条＋两行规格＋一条空参数行＋脚注框，底部另置三格参数条；图三为深场底环形印章信任墙，中心为字标、外圈六枚圆形认证印章；图四为罐背标签视角，含建议用量说明框、三行条目化主张、警示段、储存说明段、方框背书条与条码区；图五为罐侧后视角，蓝色标签面上置营养成分表、中部免责框、底边一排小印章。品类判定依据：源类目路径仅作提示，按图判为口服粉剂类营养补充，故归医药保健/营养补充；不落食品饮料/冲调（无冲饮场景与食用呈现），也不落护肤个护（无外用质地表达）。已剥离内容：品牌字标、系列名与原平台店铺字样、三格参数条与表内全部数值及成分含量、工艺与纯度类主张、认证与检测类字样、免责原句、条码、原图英文文案与圆形印章内的具体资质文字，全部改为空白参数行、空表格单元、空印章框与留空横幅；产品一律以 {product} 占位，末镜收口沿用同套斜切撞色结构（源套图无促销帧，仅复用撞色版式）。
